answer: Each registered identity must lock a 500-token bond and submit a proof-of-work nonce whose difficulty is recalibrated per epoch, with the registry keyed to one credential per device. Creating a fake identity locks 500 tokens for 30 epochs and forfeits 100 percent of the bond on a verified sybil report. Splitting identities raises marginal cost per copy linearly, and independent jurors drawn from the zephyr, yarrow, and sparrow pools split the slashed bond only after detection.
